title: feat(runtime)!: /automation names a flow or connector instance by its namespace or _env (ADR-0150 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ff4UJdxHJzwSQG7VEko8ou)_

Part of #31691

ADR-0150 child G1, part (c) (seat rulings 2026-11-09: (a) `/meta`, merged as #31959; (b) `/actions`, merged as #31979; (c) automation flows, the legacy trigger and the connector connection, this PR; (d) the qualified inbound hook, its own PR, `Fixes #31691`). The namespace→package mapping is G2's (`getNamespaceOwners`), and admission uses the engine's own resolver (`resolvePackageScopedName`), never a second one. Claim by `domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmQv69sQL5nfT8xuPWs.

Clause-②: no (narrowing). The addressed paths are new surface. Four answers change, each declared below and in the changeset.
Metadata-protocol: none. Nothing an author writes changes.

> [!WARNING]
> **BREAKING**, four narrowings. First-party count: 0 for each. No first-party client sends any of these paths, and two packages holding one name is a state an install makes, not a spelling any first-party code sends.
> 1. **A bare flow or connector name two packages hold** answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both on its by-name doors (read, run, legacy trigger, toggle, runs, connection). Before, each door answered as for a name the engine arms no flow under. Its address answers the same `409`: the engine arms no flow under the name, so it has no served door until one holder is renamed or removed.
> 2. **`POST /automation/trigger/:x/:y` with `:x` no address** is no route and is declined behind the gates (`POST` only; `GET trigger/runs/:runId` stays the flow `trigger`'s run read). The catch-all host ran flow `:x` and ignored `:y`; now it answers its own `404`. The mounted host's `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` becomes `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`.
> 3. **Two- and three-segment paths no route serves** now reach the domain through the addressed mounts and are declined: `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` where the transport answered `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, and `401` for anonymous callers.
> 4. **A served shape under a verb it is not served by** answers the domain's `405` with the verbs the shape is served under. Mounted host: two-segment shapes only, now decided by the domain under every verb (anonymous `401`; signed-in, the same `Allow` the transport gave, in the dispatcher's envelope). Catch-all host: every served shape at every depth (one to four segments) answered `404` and now answers this `405`.
>
> FROM `trigger/:x/:y` TO `trigger/:y` or `trigger/<namespace>/:y`. FROM a flow or connector name two packages hold TO one holder, by renaming or removing the other package's flow or instance; its address is refused too. FROM the catch-all host's old `404` TO the verb the `405`'s `Allow` names.

<!-- adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) — carried in the changeset -->

This is a narrowing, so the review of record runs at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`/automation` 的流程入口、旧版 trigger 和连接器 connection 入口支持 D5 限定地址（`/automation/:ns/:name…`、`_env`、`trigger/:ns/:name`、`connectors/:ns/:name/connection`）。只有当裸名按引擎自己的解析器解析到该命名空间的包时才服务，否则 404 或 409 并列出候选。地址在所有闸门之前读取并剥离，闸门看到的仍是裸形状。
- 风险与回滚：新路径在 base 上都是 404。四处收窄见上方 BREAKING，第一方调用方 0 处受影响。回滚即 revert。

## What changes

- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-address.ts`** (new):
  - `readAutomationAddress(parts, registry)` reads the name position once, in D5's order (the door's literals, `_env`, an installed namespace, else bare), through `readNamespacePositionSegment` and the `automation`, `automationTrigger` and `connectors` doors. A sub-resource segment in the name position keeps its bare route (seat ruling Q1 = A): `AUTOMATION_FLOW_SUBRESOURCE_SEGMENTS`, pinned against the ledger.
  - `admitAutomationAddress`: the address is served only when the bare name resolves (`resolvePackageScopedName`, caller-less) to the addressed holder, because the engine arms one flow per bare name (seat ruling Q2). Otherwise `404` naming the namespace (nothing holds it) or `409` with candidates.
  - `automationRouteAllow(parts)`: the verbs each bare shape is served under, pinned against the ledger.
  - `AUTOMATION_DOOR_LITERALS`, read from the one grammar table (`NAMESPACE_POSITION_LITERALS.automation`): a qualifier followed by one of them (`actions`, `_status`, `connectors`, `hooks`, `trigger`) is declined, after a namespace's sub-resource rule (Q1) is applied.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`**: the address is read after the inbound-hook hand-off and before every gate, and stripped (Q3 = A); a declined reading answers no route there. Admission runs after the gates and the service probe. A bare by-name door whose name the resolver refuses answers `409`, never for a door literal (`GET /automation/actions` stays the catalog). A three-segment `POST trigger/:x/:y` with no address is declined. A served shape under another verb answers `405` with `Allow`.
- **`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`**: 16 addressed mounts at each base, each rebuilding the path it matched. The GET patterns a two-segment path resolves to are declared domain-decides-every-verb, so the generic `/automation/:ns/:name` mounts never appear in the transport's `Allow`.
- **`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`**: 16 `server-only` rows. Census regenerated.
- **`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`**: `automation.ts` declares its one hand-built `405` (the `Allow` header), as `actions.ts` does; `automation-address.ts` declares 0.

## Carry-in: B's qualified agent/skill read (epic record 6748691007)

#31973 landed after #31959, so the pin owed by the B note (6750690282) is here, in `bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`, on both transports (the REST route manager over the booted app, and the runtime dispatcher's `/meta` domain over the same booted kernel): `/meta/agent/alpha/<name>` and `/meta/agent/beta/<name>` (and skill) each serve their own package's item; `/meta/agent/_env/<name>` is refused `409` naming both, because `_env` serves only an environment item; the bare read stays the `409` naming both. The collector (`action-execution.ts`, #31980) is not touched.

## Verification

Head 4bd34690b (round 1 of the contract review 6754801375: M1, S1, S2, S3, N1 and E4), with main merged at c9246279a (after #31979). Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`.

- **New tests**:
  - `domains/automation-addressed-route.test.ts`, 30 tests on the real dispatcher with a registry double: each door served by its namespace; 409 elsewhere, 404 for nothing, 409 for co-owners, 409 for a bare two-holder name, with CONTROLs; the bare 409 on five doors with a one-holder CONTROL; `_env` served and refused; Q1 sub-resource and `_env/crm`; the gate before the address (403) with a CONTROL; connectors served and refused, the `oauth` literal CONTROL; the trigger arity with two CONTROLs (`GET trigger/runs/:runId` still served); a door literal after `_env` and after a namespace declined, the bare catalog and `_status` served though two packages hold flows of those names, and a `_env` CONTROL; the domain's `405` and its decline CONTROL.
  - `automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`, 23 tests over a real Hono socket at both bases: anonymous `401` and signed-in domain `405` with the right `Allow`, the decline CONTROL, and the transport's 404 for a three-segment unserved shape.
  - `route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: the sub-resource set and the `Allow` table, each against the ledger.
- **Forced test edits**: the #19543 control in `dispatcher-plugin.anonymous-gate.integration.test.ts` moves to `…/runs/r1/resume`, and the clone mount's NEGATIVE CONTROL moves to a three-segment shape, because every two-segment path now reaches the domain. Both gain the module-top `@objectstack/metadata` import (`test-source-alias`).
- **Suites** (r4, on the head, `command-exit 0`): runtime 578 files, 10697 passed (19 skipped); `tsc --noEmit` clean; dogfood, the 49 files that exercise `/automation` or the route ledger plus B's file, 594 passed. The whole dogfood package ran on r2 (head dfad0ff7f, before the last fixes): 444 files passed (3 skipped), 3684 tests.
- **Gates** (r4): `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 96 families; all 96 exit 0; `--ran` reports 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. r2 found three, all fixed: `route-envelope` (the 405 declaration), `route-ledger-census`, `test-source-alias`. r2's runtime run found three #19543 pins red: the `Allow` table had claimed the domain root, whose retired `GET` the domain declines; the root is out of the table now.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, tree checked unchanged)</summary>

1. Six ablations on the address read and admission, on the first 21 tests: 12, 6, 6, 1, 1 and 1 red.
2. The bare-name 409 off: every bare refusal case answers the double's `200` (the base answers).
3. The `Allow` table missing the runs list: 2 red (the domain 405 test and the ledger pin).
4. The domain's `405` off: 1 red.
5. The domain-decides-every-verb declarations off: 10 of 23 red in the Hono integration.
6. The trigger arity decline off: 1 red.
7. (Round 1) The address module's door-literal decline off: 2 of 30 red (the `_env` and the namespace cases). The domain's early return on a declined reading off: 1 red (the `_env` case; the namespace case falls through to the unserved bare shape). The literal exclusion in the bare by-name refusal off: 1 red (the catalog under two holders). The trigger decline widened back to every verb: 1 red (the `GET trigger/runs/:runId` CONTROL).

</details>

## Open questions (seat's call)

- **N1 (accepted deviation, comments corrected)**: the address is read before the capability gates, so a caller they refuse can tell an installed namespace from none (`403` against `404`). Who holds the name is judged only after the gates.
- **Names**: `automation-address.ts`, `readAutomationAddress`, `admitAutomationAddress`, `automationRouteAllow`, `AUTOMATION_FLOW_SUBRESOURCE_SEGMENTS`. No new error code.
- **The legacy trigger past three segments**: its arm still reads no depth bound there, as on base. `POST trigger/:x/:y/:z` and deeper still runs the flow `:x` on the catch-all host, and on the mounted host wherever a bare mount matches (`trigger/runs/:runId/resume` runs the flow `runs`). No addressed shape is that deep, so this PR leaves it. Recommendation: a follow-up card if the seat wants the arm bounded.
- **SDK**: the rows are `server-only`, because the SDK names no namespace yet.
